_comment: Publisher-family container selectors, tried in this order (most specific journal platforms first, generic last). A selector matches when an element's id or class CONTAINS the token (substring match); '#token' restricts the match to id, '.token' restricts it to class, a bare token matches id or class. Bare tag names are deliberately NOT matched here: selecting a plain <main>/<article> is the job of the main_or_article fallback level, which ranks them across the whole page — a family must be a specific id/class signal so it cannot be triggered by one of many <article> teaser cards (a JATS/PMC page that is a single wrapping <article> is caught correctly there). Within a family the richest (most text) matching element wins; the first family with any match wins the whole level.
